sceneConcept: A provisional design for a sixty-two-year-old Chinese neighborhood noodle-shop owner stands alone against a transparent background. Short thinning grey hair, a receding hairline, brown eyes, a small grey mustache and a gentle familiar smile make him approachable. He wears a plain white short-sleeved work shirt, a clean black waist apron, relaxed brown trousers and worn brown shoes, with a white kitchen towel over one shoulder. His left hand holds one empty plain cream ceramic noodle bowl, while his right hand rests open at his side. Soft even frontal studio light keeps him entirely ordinary and alive. Visual refresh: a faded black apron over a warm red sweater with sleeves rolled for kitchen work.
